title: NSWP arrival context
description: The JSON inside #nswp=<base64url, no padding>. Destinations must read it, then remove it from the URL with history.replaceState before loading third-party scripts. Assertions and receipts are untrusted until verified server-side. See spec §4.4.

sessionKey.description: The secret half of the session key the pass names. Present only with `pass`.

immersive.description: True when the visitor left a headset session to make this trip.

home.description: True when this world is where the visitor starts, and their own client has brought them home.

joined.description: True when the visitor was in a room where they came from and stays among people here: the world joins its open room without asking again.

mic.description: True when their microphone was on and they have told their client it may stay on as they travel. Read only with joined.

blocked.description: Identity keys of people the visitor has blocked: their own client's list. The world connects them to nobody on it for this visit, and does not keep it.
